summary.text: Bob Hensgens is a Republican member of the Louisiana Senate for District 26, representing Acadia, Lafayette, Vermilion, according to the Senate member page.
The Senate biography says Hensgens chairs the Senate Natural Resources Committee and was elected to the Senate in November 2018.

paragraphs.text: According to his Senate biography, Hensgens was first elected to the Louisiana House of Representatives in a special election on April 30, 2011, and was elected to the Senate in November 2018.
It says he served as Vice Chairman of the House Committee on Health and Welfare and on the House Appropriations and Agriculture, Forestry, Aquaculture, and Rural Development committees.
The biography says Hensgens graduated from Vermilion Catholic High School and from the University of Louisiana at Lafayette with a Bachelor of Business Administration degree.
It says he built a health care management business and is a former Mayor of the Town of Gueydan, where he and his wife Nancy live and belong to St. Peter the Apostle Roman Catholic Church.

The Senate member page lists Bob Hensgens's committee assignments as Natural Resources (Chair); Environmental Quality; Health and Welfare; Retirement; Transportation, Highways and Public Works (Ex Officio); Atchafalaya Basin Program Oversight Committee; Joint Medicaid Oversight Committee.
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Acadiana Delegation; Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation.
